connector.name: PH Schools MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Local stdio MCP server for searching and analyzing the Philippine schools masterlist dataset.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ph-schools-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the darwinphi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.description: Optional canonical dataset tag used by sync-data when URL is not provided.
